en: Conditioned by a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement and is not wholesome, there arises a state that is defiled but not subject to defilement and is wholesome, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six in the case of root; ... pe ... six in the case of non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement and is not unwholesome, there arises a state that is defiled, subject to defilement, and unwholesome, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three in the case of root; ... pe ... three in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement and is indeterminate, there arises a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement and is indeterminate, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are six [conditions] for root; six for predominance … pe … six for non-disappearance.
